description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
暂停WAF防护状态。

- **0（默认）**：表示未暂停WAF防护。
- **1**：表示已暂停WAF防护。
description.en:
Specifies whether to pause WAF protection.

- **0 (default)**: WAF protection is not paused.

- **1**: WAF protection is paused.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-pause-protection-status --instance-id waf-cn-tl32ast0000 --pause-status 0 --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
